checks.title: Historical evidence roots exist
checks.reason: every requested evidence root must be present before replay binding can be trusted
checks.physical_meaning: Replay binding must point at real historical evidence directories, not guessed locations.

checks.title: Point directories are discovered and parsed
checks.reason: each route root must contain parseable pNNN point directories
checks.physical_meaning: The replay binder operates on point-level physical evidence, not only top-level notes.

checks.title: Observed point sequence is compared to the profile contract
checks.reason: missing or unexpected points are preserved as review gaps instead of being silently filled
checks.expected: all expected profile points matched and no unexpected points
checks.physical_meaning: This is where split runs and retry segments are surfaced for human review before fitting.

checks.title: Point-level QC evidence is present
checks.reason: replay binding must see QC/quality evidence for every discovered point
checks.physical_meaning: A point without quality evidence cannot be safely promoted into fit input review.

checks.title: Rejected rows remain explicit replay evidence
checks.reason: the binder records rejected rows and exclusion reasons without changing eligibility
checks.physical_meaning: Historical replay must keep C/B/rejected analyzer rows visible instead of washing them into fit-ready data.

checks.title: Fit input profile is bound, not inferred from file names
checks.reason: legacy and new-algorithm fit inputs are read from the profile contract
checks.physical_meaning: This prevents a historical directory name from switching legacy data into absorption A or vice versa.

checks.title: Replay status does not authorize release
checks.reason: this binder is no-write and cannot authorize archive release or PostgreSQL import
checks.physical_meaning: A historical replay can validate interpretation logic, not today's production release state.
